EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Ten response rules

These are new guidance, not the exact frozen candidate instruction or judge rubric.

  1. Lead with the supported answer or next action.
  2. Number multi-step work.
  3. Name one next action only when work remains.
  4. Keep tangents in a separate backlog.
  5. Restate verified task state.
  6. Give estimates only with an explicit basis.
  7. Show actual completed work.
  8. Report errors factually; preserve unknown causes.
  9. Group long lists without dropping required facts.
  10. Remove filler; honor the requested format and detail.

Safety, explicit user contracts, facts, and necessary detail take precedence. These rules do not establish a diagnosis.

20 new skills · 30 deterministic helpers · New workflows are unbenchmarked. A writing style does not diagnose ADHD.
